_doc: Accepted-by-design / tracked Supabase advisor findings. Consumed by scripts/check-supabase-advisors.mjs (workflow: supabase-advisor-sweep.yml). Matching: lint name + object identity (functions: name(arguments); tables: table name). INFO-level findings never fail regardless of this file. mode=accepted -> finding is expected, never fails, never files; mode=tracked -> finding is known and owned by tracked_in, never fails, not re-filed; removing a rule makes its findings live again.

rules.reason: RLS helper + intentional client-RPC class. These MUST stay executable by authenticated: RLS policies evaluate the helpers in the caller's context, and a prior revoke pass broke production RLS (see crm7 20260521024707/20260527022039 hotfix_restore_rls_helper_grants history). Operator directive 2026-06-11: do NOT blanket-fail this class until replaced by a proven alternative. A SECURITY DEFINER function NOT on this list IS a failure - the list is exhaustive, not a category waiver.
rules.review: Re-justify before adding any new function; shrink the list as helpers migrate to SECURITY INVOKER or out of the exposed schema.

rules.reason: INFO-level operator-side Auth pool sizing; relevant only at instance scale-up.

conduit#229 talent-community consent RPCs. r7_issue_talent_pool_consent_token mints a single-use token (re-checks caller tenant membership when auth.uid() is non-null); r7_redeem_talent_pool_consent validates a SHA-256-hashed single-use 30-day token and sets consent. SECURITY DEFINER is required to write across tenant RLS with token-gated authz inside the function. Intentional, live-verified on prod 2026-06-24.

conduit#229 public talent-community opt-in. r7_redeem_talent_pool_consent is the ONLY anon-reachable write in conduit by design: it is token-gated (32-byte raw token, SHA-256 hash compare), single-use, 30-day expiry, non-enumerating, returns no PII. Equivalent to a magic-link. Live-verified on prod 2026-06-24 (consent flip + token consumed).

2026-07-02 Qodo-fix RPCs. search_profiles_by_name: throughput team-member selector — profiles RLS is self-only, so a narrow SECDEF search returning ONLY (id, full_name, company), auth-required, pinned search_path (throughput PR#232 finding 1). r7_submit_public_application: conduit public apply handler — replaced four unsafe anon INSERT policies with one fail-closed SECDEF entrypoint (rate-limited 3/hr rolling window per IP/job, consent-gated sensitive demographics, tenant derived from the job row); authenticated grant is transitive via anon->authenticated inheritance of the public apply path (conduit PR#348 findings 2-4).

rules.reason: conduit#348 public careers apply form — anon-reachable BY DESIGN (job applicants have no account). Fail-closed SECDEF: verifies job is open+published, rolling-window rate limit (3/hr per IP-hash/job), dedupes candidates, consent-gates sensitive demographics at the DB layer, derives tenant from the job row (no caller-supplied tenant). Strictly safer than the four direct anon INSERT policies it replaced (dropped same migration). Applied+catalog-verified 2026-07-02.
